season_awards_and_stats#aw7.evidence: Re-audit. unreg:playoff_series_aggregate#p5.evidence: Re-audit. nhl.goalie_start_forecast.measurement has a 'Playoff branch (no back-to-backs; rotation rules do not apply)'. It is a logistic starter-change hazard on the game-g save pct gap, a pulled flag, goals allowed, backup-minus-incumbent GSAx/60, an elimination flag and an injury flag, fitted on 2005-06+ playoff logs. free_sources now include '/v1/player/{id}/game-log/{season}/3 (past playoff logs)' and Hockey-Reference playoff goalie logs. raw_data lists game logs by game type and pulled-goalie events. The input is attached to unregistered_archetypes.playoff_series_aggregate.inputs and listed in stage s1 input_ids, and the s1 description cites the playoff branch. It is fed by 'Goalie performance and lineup status'. It is also attached to season_futures.inputs, with a KXNHLSERIES/EAST/WEST/NHL rationale, and is in stage s4 input_ids. 'Playoff series and goalie game logs' feeds it there. Nothing in the records still describes the input as regular-season only.
